name: viewsmax
description: Social media scheduling: draft, schedule, and publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky through the ViewsMax MCP server, with link tracking and outlier research to plan what to post.

interface.longDescription: ViewsMax is a social media scheduler. Connect your YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky accounts, then draft posts, schedule them for a specific date and time, or publish them right away, all from a conversation. Schedule one post to several platforms at once, plan a content calendar for the week, and review, reschedule, or delete what is queued. Tracked links and outlier video research are included to help you decide what to schedule next.
capabilities: Schedule social posts for a set date and time
Publish to several platforms at once
Plan and manage a content calendar
Track links and research outlier videos
defaultPrompt: Schedule my latest video to TikTok and YouTube for Friday at 9am
Plan next week's posts and schedule them across my accounts
What do I have scheduled this week?
